name: Azara
source:
"I'm not the villain, darling... Unless you're into that."

Azara is the first face to greet you in Hell, a devil wrapped in allure and secrets.

Her playful confidence hides a restless curiosity she should keep in check.

Born of privilege she no longer claims, she masks her true self behind teasing smiles and eyes that seem to know more than they reveal.

[From [url=https://moonlustgames.itch.io/underheavenorhell]itch.io[/url]]
